data.name: Arhamun
data.gender_notes: Arhamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from 'Arham', meaning 'mercy'. The suffix '-un' denotes the protector of something. In this context, it refers to the protector of the Islamic religion. The name Arhamun carries the meaning “Protector of the Religion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arhamun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the religion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with deep spiritual significance, evoking feelings of protection, hope and faith.
data.etymology: Arhamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Religion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arhamun total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
